security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from Markdown formatting, example URLs, CSS, and project diagrams. Confirmed issues are limited to forceful process-kill reset commands, broad 0.0.0.0 server binding, and guidance that pairs public ngrok URLs with no authentication.

remediation.suggestion: Replace kill -9 examples with safer commands that list matching processes first and prefer graceful termination.

remediation.issue: Example servers bind to all network interfaces.
remediation.suggestion: Default examples to 127.0.0.1 and explain when broader binding is required for controlled tunnel testing.

remediation.issue: Development registration uses public ngrok URLs with no authentication.
remediation.suggestion: Label this as local-only and add production guidance for authentication, authorization, and secret handling.

content.value_statement: ChatGPT Apps require exact widget metadata, MCP resources, and Developer Mode setup. This skill gives templates, patterns, and debugging steps for building interactive app widgets.
actual_capabilities: Explains the window.openai APIs used by ChatGPT app widgets.
Provides FastMCP server templates with embedded widget resources.
Shows response metadata required for text/html+skybridge widgets.
Documents widget interaction patterns for buttons, selections, and tool calls.
Lists debugging steps for ngrok, widget caching, and Developer Mode setup.
limitations: It is documentation and examples, not a complete production app.
It focuses on widget-based ChatGPT Apps, not plain MCP servers.
It assumes local development with ngrok and ChatGPT Developer Mode.
Its examples require security review before production deployment.

use_cases.title: Prototype a ChatGPT Widget App
use_cases.description: Use the templates to create a local MCP app with an embedded HTML widget.

use_cases.title: Debug Widget Rendering Problems
use_cases.description: Follow checks for MIME type, response metadata, caching, and server connectivity.

use_cases.title: Teach Apps SDK Patterns
use_cases.description: Review the examples to explain widget resources, structured content, and bridge APIs.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic App Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me plan a simple ChatGPT App with one MCP tool and one widget. Include files, metadata, and test steps.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Widget Template
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a self-contained widget for my ChatGPT App. Use window.openai safely and include response metadata requirements.

prompt_templates.title: Debug a Broken Widget
prompt_templates.prompt: My ChatGPT App widget is stuck loading. Walk through MIME type, _meta, resource delivery, ngrok, and caching checks.

prompt_templates.title: Review an App for Release
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my ChatGPT App design for production readiness. Focus on authentication, network exposure, widget data handling, and deployment risks.

output_examples.input: I need a minimal ChatGPT App with a widget.
output_examples.output: A file plan, a FastMCP server outline, widget metadata notes, and a Developer Mode test checklist.

output_examples.input: My widget does not render in ChatGPT.
output_examples.output: A step-by-step debugging checklist covering server logs, MIME type, response metadata, ngrok status, and cache reset.

output_examples.input: I want action buttons inside the widget.
output_examples.output: A recommended button pattern using follow-up messages, plus limits for complex JavaScript inside ChatGPT widgets.

best_practices: Keep widgets self-contained with inline styles and explicit metadata.
Check window.openai availability before using bridge APIs.
Use authenticated, least-privilege deployment settings outside local development.
anti_patterns: Do not ship public ngrok endpoints with no authentication.
Do not rely on complex widget JavaScript without testing inside ChatGPT.
Do not place secrets in widget HTML, logs, or structured content.

faq.question: What does this skill help me build?
faq.answer: It helps build ChatGPT Apps that use MCP servers and embedded HTML widgets.

faq.question: Does it create a finished production app?
faq.answer: No. It provides templates and guidance that developers must adapt and secure.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report marks it compatible with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it cover plain MCP servers?
faq.answer: Only partly. It focuses on ChatGPT Apps with interactive widgets.

faq.question: Why does it mention ngrok?
faq.answer: ChatGPT needs a reachable MCP URL during local development and testing.

faq.question: What should I check before production use?
faq.answer: Review authentication, network exposure, secret handling, logging, and widget data boundaries.
